verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only building blocks for bulk work: the management SDK can list runs filtered by status (docs-19), and run handles support status checks, cancel and retry (docs-3). Bulk operations would have to be scripted by looping over individual runs, and no native bulk action is documented. missing for 10: documented batch triggering of many items, dashboard or API bulk cancel/replay across selected runs, MCP/agent-driven bulk actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
